items.title: 32.13 Applications of Industrial Chemistry (industrial chemistry ke istemal) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.13, printed page 240 (PDF 243). The cement flow diagram is our aid.

blocks.text: Petrochemical industry crude oil (kaccha tel) se plastics, synthetic rubber aur fibres (reshe) banati hai. Crude oil ko crack kiya jata hai (tor kar chhote molecules banaye jaate hain). Yeh chhote molecules lubricants (chiknai wale tel), waxes aur synthetic rubbers ke building blocks (bunyadi tukre) bante hain.

Cosmetics industry makeup, sabun aur perfumes (khushbuon) ke ingredients (ajza) banati hai. Yeh industry surfactants (sabun ke liye), emulsifiers (creams ko smooth yani mulaim rakhne ke liye) aur preservatives (bacteria ki barhotri rokne ke liye) istemal karti hai. Chemistry yaqeeni banati hai ke yeh cheezein insaani skin (jild) ke liye pH-balanced hon, yani na zyada acidic na zyada basic.

Cement industry limestone (choona pathar) aur clay (chikni mitti) se aik ahem building material (tameeri cheez) banati hai. Cement banane ke liye limestone aur clay ke intimate (achhi tarah mile hue) mixture ko rotary kiln (ghoomne wali bhatti) mein 1500°C tak garam kiya jata hai. Jo cheez banti hai use gypsum ke saath pees kar cement banaya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar khane teeron se jure: limestone + clay -> rotary kiln (about 1500 degree C) -> ground with gypsum -> cement.
blocks.caption: Cement banane ke qadam (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Food industry food additives (khuraak mein milayi jaane wali cheezein), preservatives aur food processing chemicals banati hai. Sodium benzoate zyada tar preservative ke taur par use hota hai. Hydrogenation se edible oils (khane ke tel) ko margarine jaisi solid fat (thos charbi) mein badla jata hai. Baking mein sodium bicarbonate (baking soda) jaise leavening agents (aata phulane wali cheezein) use hote hain. Fortification (khuraak mein vitamins ya minerals barhana) ke liye namak mein iodine ya tel mein Vitamin A milaya jata hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Paani milane par cement garam kyun hota hai? Cement paani se exothermic (heat chhorne wala) hydration reaction karta hai aur heat release karta (chhorta) hai. Isi liye taaza mila hua cement garam ho jata hai.

blocks.explanation: Limestone aur clay ka achhi tarah mila mixture rotary kiln mein 1500°C tak garam kiya jata hai, aur bani hui cheez ko gypsum ke saath peesa jata hai.

items: Petrochemicals: crude oil ki cracking se plastics, rubber, fibres.
Cement: limestone + clay, rotary kiln 1500°C, phir gypsum ke saath peesna.
Food: sodium benzoate, hydrogenation (margarine), baking soda, fortification.
